Comparatives · 要点精讲(第2轮): Comparatives compare two things; mind the -er spelling changes of short adjectives.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Short adjectives take -er + than; long adjectives take more + adjective + than。

Short adjectives add -er: taller, longer|Double the final consonant: big → bigger, hot → hotter|Long adjectives use more: more beautiful|irregular: good → better, bad → worse|The comparison must include than
This box is heavier than that one.

# title: 「这个箱子比那个重。」的正确英文是?
Comparatives · 要点精讲(第2轮): This box is heavy than that one.|This box is heavier than that one.|This box is heaviest than that one.|This box is more heavy than that one.
column4: 考查Short adjectives take -er + than; long adjectives take more + adjective + than。正确句:This box is heavier than that one.
